newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 29.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* The ringgit made a sharp recovery starting late Asian trading Monday. It is at 2.6330/60 to a dollar against over 2.65 before the recovery started.
* On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was resumed its uptrend, gaining 7.67 points to 8,121.11
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index was down 11.85 points or 1.14 percent at 1,029.41. The small capitalised shares second board index was off 2.41 points to 547.88.

* "Ringgit's recovery would in some way lessen the extent of earnings downgrade (of Malaysian companies). But, for the moment, I don't see any further sharp rally in the ringgit," said a dealer with a bank-backed brokerage.
* Dealers contacted said share prices would continue to be in a range with possibility of further downside before a recovery since foreigners were still selling.
* Jaya Tiasa expected to be in focus after results
